verdict.rationale: Factory supports reviewing and merging git diffs produced by droid-driven changes (factory-docs-1, factory-docs-2), which gives some review/rollback capability for code changes, but there's no direct evidence of versioning, reviewing, or rolling back the automations themselves (Skills, Custom Droids, Missions configurations). Missing for 10: explicit version history for Skills/Custom Droids/Missions, a rollback mechanism for automation definitions (not just code diffs), and audit trail of automation changes over time.
